I didn't record 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply, because the team's files say 40. I replied to Tobias in his #central-team thread to tell him that.

What the files show:
- The Affiliate Amendment, effective 2025-10-15, sets Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1.
- The 2026 renewal order form (signed 22 Apr 2026, effective 1 May 2026, term to 30 Apr 2027) leaves Agrisupply's seat count as the amendment set it.
- The MAS account page, updated 2026-09-15, also says 40 seats.

I asked Tobias to point me to any newer amendment or order form that shows 382, and said I'd update the record if he does. The only figures I shared were seat counts and dates; the per-seat price in the order form stayed out of the reply.
